title: Glass Shelf with Towel Bar 16-Inch Wall Mount Tempered Glass & Solid Brass Waverly Place Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf with Towel Bar 16-Inch Wall Mount
description:
Add wall-mounted storage and towel hanging in one with this 16-inch glass shelf and integrated towel bar, crafted with 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware.

Highlights:
- Clever integrated towel bar helps keep hand towels within reach while freeing up counter space
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass adds safety and everyday strength
- Beveled-edge glass for a clean, finished look
- Solid brass hardware for enduring performance
- Designer finish designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Shelf glass size: 16 x 5 inches
- Projection: 5 inches
- Wall mount installation; assembly required: no
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4)
- Collection: Waverly Place Collection (coordinate with matching Waverly Place pieces)
- Style: transitional bath accessories / transitional bathroom hardware; versatile bath accessories
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors
